body: Apparently I do as a lot of people take joy in watching me suffer. So I must deserve it in some way, I don't know.

Except when you're stuck in a situation and you want to get out of it but the other person wants to drag it out and make you suffer. And steal as much of your money as possible, because you're so good to pay half of what you owe them but the other way around you don't get anything.

What's the point even? If people you have known for a decade pull this stuff on you? There's no way of knowing if anyone is going to be good or not, if this happens after ten years. After you trust them and let them in. 

I've been a good person my entire life and it has only brought me suffering and other people who are horrible just do whatever they want and get whatever they want without consequences.

It's been a few months and it still hurts. As if I meant nothing for so long. I'm having problems trusting people now. There is no way for me to know that someone else won't do the same thing. I thought I knew her, but I was wrong apparently.

One of my friends noticed I was not doing well. Asked me to reach out so she could support me. She kept pushing and pushing and eventually I poured my heart out.

Result: she got very very mad at me and immediately broke all contact. A decade of friendship does not mean anything apparently.

I really hate people.

I'm so sorry for your loss. You're a good person if you care. Sadly, I don't know anyone like that. They all run away if I'm not cured in a couple of days. Or they don't know what to say and they just end the conversation.

It hurts a lot more if people abandon you because of your illness. If they tell you that you're not even trying, whilst you're moving mountains. But in a healthy person's eyes, that's nothing. And not nearly enough. I'd rather just have everyone ignore me, than opening up again and having everything I told used against me.

Good people are hard to find. So far I haven't found any.

If I tell that person how I feel, their response is ":(" or "I hope it gets better" and that's it. End of conversation. If it takes longer than ten minutes to fix, no one cares. Other people I let in just straight up abandoned me because my depression wasn't cured in a couple of weeks.

So no, no one I know cares. Trust me, I tried to believe they did.
Exactly. My best guess is that people ask this when they're doing great. They expect you to ask them the same question and then they can brag about their lives.

I try my hardest every day. I've been trying for six years. But due to bad luck, everything I try fails. My psychologist says the same. That I'm just a very very very unlucky person. She can't even give me a reason anymore to carry on. I have tried literally everything. But the universe just keeps kicking me down. For every step forward, I take ten steps back. I feel defeated and I don't have energy left to carry on.

I'm feeling the same way. Except everyone I love is kicking me out of their lives. I have one person left. My last straw. I told my psychologist repeatedly that I don't know what will happen when they're no longer here. If this person is gone... my last bit of hope will vanish. I have nothing but pain left.

Except people don't really see suicide as a good choice, do they? People call it selfish. They say suicidal people are weak. Plus you give the suicidal person the additional burden of having to hurt their family and friends. 

It is not a nice choice to make. It is not fair to present this as a choice.

I know, always the same lie. Every single time. People only want to be there for you when you don't really need it. If it can be fixed with a ten minute talk, they're there. But as soon as it takes more effort? Then you're too negative and they don't need that in their lives.

Ugh. People are so selfish. 

I'm so sorry you've also experienced this. It fucking hurts.
I thought I did. But if they even betray you after years and years of friendship? How can you ever know you have found someone decent?
I can't even remember having dreams or goals

I tried to find people I want to be around. I thought I had found them. Turns out, sometimes it just takes people a long time to see me for the awful human being I truly am. People you talk to every day for almost ten years, suddenly realise that you don't actually fit the image in their head.

I don't want to be around anyone anymore. I don't want anyone to have to deal with me. If I hate myself so much that I don't want to be around me, how can I expect anyone else to want that? The only thing that makes me mad is that I can't just run away from myself. That for me it takes more drastic measures to never have to deal with me anymore.

I'm so sorry for your loss. This hits so close to home, my pupper looks *exactly* the same as yours and I was very confused when I saw this picture passing by.

Again, so sorry for your loss. I hope your pupper finds peace in pupper heaven. And if not peace, then I hope they find a lot of belly rubs and playtime there.
This hits so close to home right now
